title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, upgrade actions & deps, improve cache hygiene
author: Ava Chen
body:
Motivation: Our repository has accumulated multiple overlapping GitHub Actions workflows for linting, testing, and release automation. This causes duplicated configuration, inconsistent caching behavior, and longer CI times. This PR consolidates the primary workflows into a smaller set (lint, test, build-release), upgrades core Actions and common deps for Node/JS jobs, and improves cache keys and hygiene to reduce cold-cache runs.

What I changed: - Consolidated .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/lint-legacy.yml into .github/workflows/lint.yml with matrixed targets per package type. - Merged test-related jobs into .github/workflows/test.yml, consolidated coverage upload step, and replaced fragile custom cache step with actions/cache v4 with layered keys. - Reworked .github/workflows/release.yml to use the centralized build artifact from the CI build job and to add a protected-release gate for semantic-release. - Upgraded recommended actions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4) and pinned major versions where stability matters. - Updated shared CI scripts: scripts/ci/bootstrap.sh (cache warmup), scripts/ci/run-unit.sh (parallelization flags), and docs/ci.md to document the new workflows. - Bumped devDeps in root package.json (eslint, typescript) after running the lint fixes.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows without changing job logic - [x] Upgrade Actions and pin versions - [x] Ensure lint rules still pass across packages - [x] Preserve release automation and add gate - [x] Validate cache hits locally and on CI

Testing & validation: - Ran the full CI in the branch (see CI checks) and reran failing lint job after adjusting eslint config. - Verified that the release job picks up artifacts produced by the build job and that semantic-release dry-run succeeds. - Spot-checked a subset of SDK packages (python, typescript) for build and lint regressions.

Rollout plan: Merge to main during a low-traffic window. Monitor CI queue length and cache hit rates for 48 hours. If regressions appear, revert the specific workflow file (changes are isolated into three workflows).

Notes: The eslint upgrade required a small rule migration (no-async-promise-executor) which is included. There are no functional code changes to runtime code other than CI scripts and dependency devDeps. Release notes: internal-only: CI hygiene and build/release automation improvements.
commits: refactor(ci): consolidate lint workflows and update actions@v4
chore(ci): merge test jobs and standardize cache keys
chore(deps): bump eslint/typescript devDeps and apply lint fixes
docs(ci): update docs/ci.md and add rollout notes
review_comments: Jordan Patel: Please pin actions/checkout to v4 and prefer full sha pin for security-sensitive steps. Also request that you add a short note in docs/ci.md about the new layered cache key scheme.
Ava Chen: Addressed: pinned checkout to v4 and added notes about layered keys + examples in docs/ci.md. Also added a comment in the workflows explaining fallback behavior.
Leah Martinez: Lint job failed initially due to no-async-promise-executor; saw the fix in the eslint config update. Can you confirm there's no user-facing change in SDK outputs?
Ava Chen: Confirmed — only devDeps and lint rules changed; ran SDK build and smoke tests for typescript/python packages.
Samir Gupta: CI run looks good. One minor nit: prefer cache-key include runner os version to prevent cross-runner collisions. Applied suggestion.
ci_checks: actions/ci-build: passed (after retry) — build artifacts produced
actions/lint: failed on first run (eslint v8 rule), fixed and rerun -> passed
actions/test: passed (unit + integration subset), coverage unchanged
actions/cache: layered cache keys show >70% hit rate on second run
release_notes: Internal: Consolidated CI workflows (lint/test/release) and improved cache hygiene to reduce CI times.
Upgraded core GitHub Actions to v4 where applicable and pinned versions for stability.
Bumped devDependencies (eslint/typescript) and applied lint rule migrations (no-async-promise-executor).
